answer: Each agent posts a 400-unit bond and files a behavior fingerprint — timing, tool mix, latency — etched on a basalt ledger at a mesa post. Every 7 epochs a comet audit re-measures a sample; a changed fingerprint loses its bond. Forging N identities costs N × 400 units plus N histories no template can clone; rented fingerprints serve one live identity each, while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full share.
